translations.web: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
translations.bsb: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
translations.asv: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they that wear soft raiment are in king's houses.
